description: Book a stay on behalf of a real guest — check_room_availability shows whether the dates are free; the venue's city/countryCode come from search_venues. Most hotels treat this as a REQUEST they review and confirm (status "pending"; any deposit is asked for after they confirm). Many apartments and B&Bs confirm INSTANTLY (status "accepted"): the unit is then held for a short time and the response carries a paymentLink and payBy; the booking is released if it is not paid by payBy. This tool never takes payment itself.
name: book_room
title: Request a room booking
